sections.label: Tightening formula milk advertising rules
sections.summary: Regulations on labelling and advertising of formula milk are intended to be tightened to strengthen consumer protection.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: To further strengthen consumer protection, we intend to tighten regulations on labelling and advertising of formula milk.

sections.label: Expanding Act to information accuracy
sections.summary: Clause 2 expands the Act's scope to ensuring companies provide adequate and accurate information and preventing misleading information.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: First, clause 2 of the amendment Bill will expand the scope of the Act from securing the wholesomeness, purity and safety of food, to ensuring that companies provide adequate and accurate information and preventing them from providing misleading information.

sections.label: Regulations on promotional information, breastfeeding statements
sections.summary: The amendment allows regulations for suitable promotional information and requires infant formula companies to place breastfeeding-encouraging statements on labels.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This will allow regulations to be enacted to ensure that promotional information is provided in a suitable manner that helps consumers make informed choices instead of confusing or misleading consumers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: This amendment also allows us to require infant formula companies to place statements encouraging breastfeeding on their labels.

sections.label: AVA food recalls when safety in doubt
sections.summary: Clause 8 allows AVA to effect food recalls when safety or suitability is in doubt or contamination is suspected, without awaiting investigation and testing.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Instead of waiting for the outcome of such an investigation and testing, clause 8 allows AVA to effect food recalls when the safety or suitability of the food or food contact article is in doubt or contamination is suspected.

sections.label: Licensing non-retail food businesses
sections.summary: Clauses 10 and 11 empower AVA to license all non-retail food businesses such as warehouses, wholesalers and distributors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Clauses 10 and 11 will empower AVA to license all non-retail food businesses, such as warehouses, wholesalers and distributors.

sections.label: Licensing food warehouses, fees
sections.summary: AVA has engaged industry with over 1,000 warehouses registered voluntarily, and will progressively license them, with fees pegged to warehouse size and not exceeding $600 a year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA has already started engaging the industry, and over 1,000 food warehouses have registered on a voluntary basis.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: AVA will progressively license these food warehouses starting with the ones storing high-risk items like infant or baby food and products that require proper temperature control like ice cream and yoghurt.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Dr Koh Poh Koon) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Licensing fees will be pegged to the size of the warehouse and will not exceed $600 a year.

sections.label: Act expands to public health
sections.summary: The Act seeks to expand beyond food safety and promote public health, especially in the war on diabetes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: This has given rise to many challenges, including those relating to both food safety as well as health concerns due to the sub-nutritional content of many processed foods.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: So, it is most opportune that the Act seeks to expand beyond just food safety and also take a big step forward in promoting public health, especially as we embark on the war on diabetes.

sections.label: Recalls and warehouse licensing
sections.summary: Expanded recall powers for suspected contamination and licensing of food storage warehouses strengthen oversight and public confidence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: Expanding the powers of the Act in effective recalls of food items suspected of contamination rather than only after confirmation will also further boost public confidence in our already strict food safety regime.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: The licensing of food storage warehouses would also strengthen oversight on our supply chain.

sections.label: Enforcing standards for influencers
sections.summary: The question asks how AVA will enforce proper standards when claims are made through third party advocates or influencers.

sentences.speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: How will AVA, therefore, enforce proper standards, especially if the claims are made through third party advocates or perhaps influencers that are seemingly at arms-length to the manufacturer but may well be paid for by them to promote their products in a misleading way?

sections.label: Clause 3 advertisement definition
sections.summary: Clause 3 amends section 2 to define advertisement broadly, excluding personal opinion made for no commercial gain.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Clause 3 amends section 2 of the Act to make an "advertisement" mean: anything "used or apparently used to promote, directly or indirectly, the sale of food"; "any words, whether written or in an audible message"; "any still or moving picture, sign, symbol or visual image" and "any combination of two or more of these things." The amendments do take pains to state that the definition "does not include communications of personal opinion made by an individual for no commercial gain to the public or section of the public in relation to any goods or services, brand of goods or services, or person who provides goods or services".

sections.label: Influencer followers and payment
sections.summary: A top millennial Instagrammer can have over half a million followers, and clients pay top influencers $1,000 to $3,000 per post.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: As a benchmark, our Prime Minister has about 300,000 followers on Instagram, but a top millennial Instagrammer in Singapore can boast over half a million followers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And that is why clients are willing to pay top influencers here between $1,000 and $3,000 per Instagram post.

sections.label: Declaring commercial interests in posts
sections.summary: The question asks whether sponsorship, freebies, gifts, discounts or opportunity-in-kind count, and whether influencers must declare commercial interests.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Aside from an obvious exchange of money or cut of profits, does it also include any provision of sponsorship, freebies, gifts, discounts or commercial opportunity-in-kind?

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So, can I clarify whether this is true?

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And, if not, whether this Bill or laws elsewhere require that social media influencers declare openly to the public which of their personal posts selling food has commercial interests in it.

sections.label: Definition of food and advertising
sections.summary: New section 2A defines food broadly, and section 16A makes false or deceptive food advertising an offence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The new section 2A now defines "food" to include "any substance capable of being used or represented as being for use for human consumption", "any substance	...capable of being used, or represented as being for use, as an ingredient or additive" as well as "anything that is or is intended to be mixed with or added to any food or drink".

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Would an individual, who sells such products to their networks online and offline, thus be considered as running a "food business" and, thus, will have their words advertising these products held accountable under this law?

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: I note also how the new section 16A of this Act makes non-compliant advertising that "is false" or "likely to deceive a buyer" as to "the age, composition, effects, nature, origin, purity, quality or strength of the food or the safety or suitability of the food" a legal offence.

sections.label: Sugar in juice and formula
sections.summary: The passage compares sugar in processed fruit juice to Coke and notes a Healthier Choice formula milk with 52 grammes sugar per 100 grammes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And drinking a cup of 100% "no added sugar" processed fruit juice is not that far off from drinking a cup of regular Coke.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: And, by the way, there is a big-brand powdered formula milk marketed as a Healthier Choice "lower sugar" product for kids aged two years and above that has 52 grammes of sugar per 100 grammes of formula.

sections.label: Sugar in Milo and formula
sections.summary: A lower sugar Milo drink has 5 grammes sugar per 100 millilitres, less than formula milk, prompting scrutiny of growing-up formulas.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: As a benchmark, a bottle of lower sugar Milo drink sold as a Healthier Choice for adults and teenagers says a 100 	millilitres serving of their prepared drink contains 5 grammes of sugar, which is less than formula milk.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: So, I think it is worth looking at exactly how much sugar is being used to pad up expensive "growing-up" formulas marketed to parents in competition with regular, cheaper, unsweetened milk for children aged one and above.

sections.label: Healthier Choice label and labelling
sections.summary: The passage warns the Healthier Choice label may lose value and cites US research finding calorie labelling caused no meaningful behaviour shift except at Starbucks.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The Healthier Choice label will lose its value if it is increasingly perceived as just clever marketing strategy by the food industry that takes advantage of the added value created by the state's endorsement.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Despite years of having more detailed food labels around, Americans actually got more unhealthy and, overall, daily consumption of calories even increased by 400.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Researchers from the International Journal of Behavioural Nutrition and Physical Activity studied the effect on consumer behaviour after American fast food chains were ordered by the government to post calorie counts.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: They discovered that there was no clinically meaningful shift in consumer behaviour across all fast food chains except at Starbucks where the introduction of labelling did cause more consumers to eat a modest 6% fewer calories per transaction.

sentences.speaker: Ms Kuik Shiao-Yin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: The law professor and consumer market regulation expert, Omri Ben-Shahar, pointed out that the difference could be that Starbucks customers were generally of a higher income bracket and argued that if America wanted to see the behavioural effect go beyond the elite food market, it had to go beyond providing just more information, to providing more practical help, like subsidies, to enable lower income families to eat better.

sections.label: Definition of food business
sections.summary: Proposed section 2B defines food business as handling or selling food, including online and primary production, regardless of commercial, charitable or one-time nature.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: In the Bill, there is a new definition of "food business" in the proposed section 2B. "Food business" is defined as a business or an undertaking or activity that involves, either in whole or in part, the handling of food intended for sale, the actual sale of food, including over the Internet and primary food production.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: It is further stated that an activity will be considered a food business regardless of whether it is of a commercial, charitable or community nature and even if it is a one-time activity.

sections.label: Penalties and TCM shops
sections.summary: Non-compliance with directions carries a fine up to $10,000 and up to a year's imprisonment, with concerns raised by traditional Chinese medicine shops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Non-compliance with any directions carries a fine of up to $10,000 and imprisonment of up to a year or both.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For instance, I have received concerns from owners of traditional Chinese medicine shops.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: These shops mainly sell herbs and Chinese medicines, but may devote a small part of their shop to selling herbal tea eggs or herbal teas; these form a very minor part of their business, earning some of them less than $50 per day.

sections.label: AVA compensation for mistakes
sections.summary: The speaker welcomes a provision recognising AVA may make mistakes and requiring AVA to compensate persons who suffer loss from such mistakes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: First, let me say I welcome this provision, as it recognises that AVA may make mistakes, and it is welcomed that AVA is undertaking a responsibility to pay compensation to persons who suffer loss due to such mistakes.

sections.label: Compensation for recall reputational loss
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether AVA will compensate a business owner for loss of reputation and future business after a food recall order.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: For instance, an order to recall food and to display a Statement on the recall would result not only in wasted costs, but also cause reputational loss to the business owner, from which he may never recover.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: Will AVA compensate the business owner for loss of reputation and future business?

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: My concern is that the new powers of AVA must be carefully calibrated for different classes of activities, to take into account the nature and extent of the risk posed.

sections.label: Regulating food sources and preparation
sections.summary: The speaker supports amendments to clauses 3 and 4 on food, food items, food handling and preparation, and food advertisements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: There is thus a need to be able to better regulate the sources from which our food items are prepared and made in.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Hence, I support the comprehensive amendments made to clauses 3 and 4 of this Bill which relate to food, food items, food handling and preparation, as well as advertisements involving food.

sections.label: Regulating home-based food handlers
sections.summary: The speaker says home-based chefs, cooks and bakers should be part of a regulated, accredited group trained in food safety and regularly audited.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: In addition, while we support the entrepreneurism of home-based chefs, cooks and bakers, we do need them to be part of a more regulated and accredited group of food handlers, preparers and sellers who (a) are trained in proper food handling, preparation and safety; and (b) who undergo regular audits to ascertain the cleanliness, quality and safety of the food they prepare, cook and sell.

sections.label: Regulating online food advertising and sale
sections.summary: The speaker asks whether new section 16A can address online advertising and sale of food items and how the Ministry can monitor such sources.

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Will the new section 16A be able to fully address the advertising and sale of food items, especially those done through online means?

sentences.speaker: Dr Intan Azura Mokhtar (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: How can the Ministry comprehensively monitor and regulate such online sources?

sections.label: Milk formula hospital marketing inquiry
sections.summary: A May inquiry report by the Competition Commission of Singapore found milk formula manufacturers invest significantly in hospital marketing activities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: An inquiry report by the Competition Commission of Singapore in May found that milk formula manufacturers invest significantly into marketing activities in hospitals to try to leverage on this.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The report stated, "In particular, the hospital channel receives a significantly higher share of marketing expenditure compared to its share of total revenue.

sections.label: Code review and soft law
sections.summary: The speaker hopes the Code review addresses sponsorships and rotation fees, but notes the Code is soft law without penalties for breaches.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: While I hope the review of the Code will address sponsorships and rotation fee practices, the Code is, ultimately, soft law and does not provide for penalties or consequences where the Code is breached.

sections.label: Code of Ethics as law
sections.summary: The question asks whether the Ministry would consider making the Code of Ethics on the Sale of Infant Foods a binding food regulation.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Would the Ministry consider incorporating the Code of Ethics on the Sale of Infant Foods in Singapore as a food regulation to give it the binding force of law?

sections.label: Expanding Act to public health
sections.summary: The Ministry proposes expanding the Act from food safety regulation to public health promotion, with label content and tighter advertisement control.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: The Ministry is proposing that the role of the Act be expanded from the regulation of food safety to the promotion of public health.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: It seeks to provide consumers with content on labels which will enable them to make informed choices.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: There will also be tighter control over advertisements to disallow certain health benefits claims or projections of misleading images.

sections.label: AVA powers over recalled food
sections.summary: With the amendments, AVA will be empowered to direct the storage and disposal of recalled food posing public health safety concerns.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: Lastly, with the amendments, AVA will be empowered to direct the storage and disposal of recalled food which poses public health safety concerns.

sections.label: Sale of Food Amendment Bill
sections.summary: The Sale of Food (Amendment) Bill seeks to expand the Act to regulate food to promote public health and enable informed consumer choices.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The Sale of Food (Amendment) Bill is noteworthy in that it seeks to expand the Act to regulate food to promote public health and ensure that the provision of information relating to food helps and enables consumers to make informed choices.

sections.label: New section 16 offence
sections.summary: New section 16 prohibits selling food packaged or labelled non-compliantly, and prosecution need not prove intent for the offence.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Next, the new section 16 prohibits the selling of food that is packaged or labelled in a manner that does not comply with the requirements of the Act and, importantly, the provision states that in the prosecution for such an offence, it is not necessary for the prosecution to prove that the defendant intended to commit the offence.

sections.label: Infant formula misleading advertising onus
sections.summary: New section 16(A) puts the onus on infant milk formula suppliers to prove label health and nutritional claims, with fines or up to three months' imprisonment for failure.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: The new section 16(A) thus helps regulate misleading advertising in the infant milk formula market as the onus is on suppliers of infant milk formula to prove that the health and nutritional claims they put on labels are, indeed, true.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sun Xueling (Pasir Ris-Punggol)
sentences.text: Failure to do so could result in a fine or imprisonment of a period not exceeding three months.

sections.label: Fine for unapproved health claims
sections.summary: Any company found using an unapproved health claim may be fined up to $5,000.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Any company found using an unapproved health claim may be fined up to $5,000.

sections.label: AVA regulation of food claims
sections.summary: The Bill strengthens the existing framework by letting AVA regulate a wider variety of claims on food labels, advertisements and promotions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: What the Bill does is to strengthen our existing framework by allowing AVA to regulate a wider variety of claims on food labels, as well as advertisements and promotions.

sections.label: Limiting claims and infant formula images
sections.summary: The amendments limit claims to those enabling informed consumer choices and prevent misleading conduct in food sales, tightening rules on health and nutrition claims and idealised infant formula images.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: These amendments will allow us to limit claims to those that enable consumers to make informed choices and prevent any misleading conduct in connection with the sale of food.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We intend to tighten regulations on health and nutrition claims and idealised images on infant formula labels.

sections.label: Consulting industry on prohibition scope
sections.summary: The scope of the prohibitions is being studied and the industry consulted, with regulatory changes to be announced by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We are studying the scope of the prohibitions and are consulting with the industry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will announce our regulatory changes by the end of this year.

sections.label: SIFECS review and affordable formula
sections.summary: SIFECS is reviewing its Code of Ethics including industry sponsorship guidelines, while MOH engages hospitals and industry to make more affordable ready-to-feed infant formula brands available for hospitals.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The Sale of Infant Formula Ethics Committee Singapore (SIFECS) is also conducting a holistic review of its Code of Ethics, including a review on the existing guidelines on industry sponsorships.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: MOH is engaging hospitals and industry players to make available more affordable infant formula brands in the ready-to-feed form that are suitable for use in hospitals.

sections.label: Infant formula labelling alignment
sections.summary: SIFECS guidelines on infant formula labelling are intended to be aligned with Singapore's Food Regulations.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Indeed, we are intending to align some of the SIFECS guidelines on infant formula labelling with our Food Regulations.

sections.label: Food sold must comply
sections.summary: Food products sold in Singapore must comply with the Sale of Food Act requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Any food products that are put up for sale in Singapore must comply with requirements in the Sale of Food Act (SOFA).

sections.label: Timely AVA interventions
sections.summary: The amendments allow AVA to intervene more timely to stop sale of suspected unsafe food or food contact articles.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The amendments will now allow more timely interventions by AVA to stop the sale of suspected unsafe food or food contact articles.

sections.label: Verifying recalled products before disposal
sections.summary: AVA officers verify product details before disposal to ensure recalled products cannot be recycled or repackaged for resale in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Prior to the disposal, AVA officers will verify the details of the products to ensure that they actually match the batch of products which has been recalled.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: These measures ensure that the recalled products cannot be recycled or repackaged for resale in Singapore.

sections.label: New Part IIA empowers AVA
sections.summary: The new Part IIA will empower AVA to issue directions for food safety purposes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The new Part IIA will empower AVA to issue directions for the purposes of food safety.

sections.label: AVA action on suspected contamination
sections.summary: In food recalls, the new Act allows AVA to act when it suspects food is contaminated.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In cases of food recalls, the new Act also allows AVA to take action when it suspects that the food is contaminated.

sections.label: Compensation evaluated case by case
sections.summary: Each compensation case will be individually evaluated because circumstances vary.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As for compensation, each case will have to be individually evaluated because they all have varied circumstances.

sections.label: Exemptions for food innovation
sections.summary: Exemptions from the Act are needed to facilitate food innovation and trade where public health risk is negligible, such as the 2016 L-theanine case.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Mr Louis Ng asked about the need to allow the Director-General of AVA to grant exemptions from the provisions of the Act.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: This provision is needed to facilitate food innovation and trade, in situations where there is actually negligible risk to public health.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For example, there was a case of a food additive that was called L-theanine detected in a brand of Taiwanese milk tea in 2016.

sections.label: Broader scope of Act
sections.summary: Section 10A lets AVA direct a class of persons, defining a broader scope to compel those creating public health hazards to stop.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim
sentences.text: On the one hand, I find that reassuring, but on the other hand, if we look at the proposed section 10A, it does state that the AVA may give directions to a class of persons.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: As I had explained earlier, the whole idea is to ensure that this Act encompasses all establishments, whether they are public events or whether they are a food business that actually causes food to be consumed by the public for which a public health risk is present.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: So, it is meant to define a broader scope so that we can have the powers to compel someone who is actually creating a public health hazard to stop what they are doing based on the risk that we assess to be present.
